entry.title: RAG LLMs are Not Safer: A Safety Analysis of Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Large Language Models

link.title: RAG LLMs are Not Safer: A Safety Analysis of Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Large Language Models

entry.content:
In this blog post, I am sharing the presentation slides from my recent talk on this topic. Feel free to explore the slides below to dive deeper into the methodology, safety analysis, and insights.

Presentation Slides: Link to slides
entry.summary: The presentation analyzes the safety of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) in Large Language Models (LLMs), demonstrating that RAG systems are significantly less safe than standard LLMs because retrieving safe external documents can still cause otherwise safe models to bypass their safety training and generate unsafe outputs.
